XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadic failure to start and/or ignition with immediate shutdown.

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Fuel supply.

  • Component: Low-pressure fuel pump.

  • Fault: On the first start-up with a cold engine, the vehicle intermittently fails to start or stalls suddenly immediately after starting.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Faulty low-pressure fuel pump

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the low-pressure fuel pump and, if necessary, replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component can be accessed after removing the rear seat, via the inspection hatch on the driver’s side, located approximately in the centre.
